svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cap: a 260 mm square of 3 mm sheet; round the corners.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Legs: three 145 mm lengths of 20 x 3 mm flat bar, each bent 90

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: degrees 30 mm from one end to make a foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: rivet each leg's long part to the outside of the flue top,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 120 degrees apart, two 4.8 mm rivets, so the bent feet stand

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 56 mm above the flue's top edge. Rivet the cap onto the feet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The cap's underside sits about 58 mm above the outlet: never

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: less, or it chokes the draft.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the gap under the cap is the same all round.
